name: copilot-brain
description: Output channel showing every Copilot Chat request: model (even in Auto), tokens, context fill, latency, cost and thinking.

copilotBrain.showThinking.description: Print the model's thinking text under each request, when Copilot records it.

copilotBrain.showTools.description: Print each agent step (Read file, Search, Run command...) and a per-turn summary from the chat session.

copilotBrain.showBackground.description: Include background requests (titles, todo agent, summaries), not just chat panel turns.
